comments.body:
The diagnosis is right and the fix is the correct shape. Comparing every format with `any(...)` is what that loop was always meant to do, and the Lex, API Gateway and Greengrass multi-format types all behave correctly now, with genuinely mismatched action/resource pairs still reported.

One thing to fix before this can go in: `test/unit/rules/resources/iam/test_statement_resources.py:371` is 97 characters and trips ruff's E501, which fails the `style` job. Shortening the alias id in that ARN is enough — the exact value doesn't matter to the case.

Two optional additions if you want them in the same push: a case where a multi-format type genuinely doesn't match, say `lex:RecognizeText` with an S3 ARN asserting the error, and one API Gateway or Greengrass case, since the fix covers those too but only Lex is tested.

There's a second half to this bug you may have noticed. `arn_formats` is assigned inside the resource-type loop and read in the `else:` after it, so when an action maps to several resource types the message only lists the last one's formats — `lex:CreateBot` reports the `bot alias` forms and omits `bot/`. Happy to take that here if you'd like to fold it in, or as a follow-up.
